answer: To forge 1,000 identities I must lock 240 units per identity into escrow for 15 epochs: 240,000 units frozen before one reward arrives. The onyx escrow lets anyone challenge an identity within a 3-epoch window, and a 9-member jury rules within 2 epochs, so my raven clones sit exposed. If 30 percent get caught, 72,000 units are slashed at 80 percent, and 25 percent of the slash, 14,400 units, goes to the challengers. The wharf where I planned to cash out stays empty: caught identities are banned for 12 epochs. My expected loss is 57,600 units per batch.
